data: Apple's diluted earnings per share were **$6.13 in fiscal 2023** (year ended September 30, 2023), up from **$6.11 in fiscal 2022** (year ended September 24, 2022). That is an increase of $0.02, or about **0.3%**. Net income for fiscal 2023 was **$96,995 million (about $97.0 billion)**, down roughly 2.8% from $99,803 million in fiscal 2022. Diluted EPS still rose slightly despite lower net income because the diluted share count fell from about 16.33 billion to 15.81 billion shares, mainly through share repurchases of $77.6 billion during fiscal 2023.
